definition_zh: 让；允许；出租；让……通过；防碍（let up 减弱）
definition_en: to allow something to happen; to permit; to rent out property; to stop or become weaker in let up
core_image: 手一松开，门就开了
scene: 哨声未落，门卫摇了摇头。Let me pass, please — the meeting starts in five minutes.
sceneCN: 这里 let 是「允许」（第 1 个义项：让；允许）；句意为请让我过去，会议五分钟后开始。

derivatives.zh: let 加 -ing 名词化，指「出租业务」（英式）

senses.title: To allow or permit
senses.definition: to give permission for something to happen
senses.definitionCN: 允许某事发生
senses.example: Let me pass, please.
senses.exampleCN: 请让我过去。
senses.why: The gate opens because the holder chooses not to block it: permission is a loosened grip.
senses.whyCN: 门之所以开，是因为掌门者选择不拦：允许就是松开的手。

senses.title: To cause to happen (in suggestions)
senses.definition: used to make suggestions or commands, as in let us go
senses.definitionCN: 用于提建议或下指令，如 let us go
senses.example: Let us begin.
senses.exampleCN: 我们开始吧。
senses.why: The speaker opens a door for shared action, so the verb frames proposals.
senses.whyCN: 说话者为共同行动开一扇门，动词于是构成提议框架。

senses.title: To rent out
senses.definition: to allow someone to use a house or room in return for rent
senses.definitionCN: 允许他人在付费条件下使用房屋或房间
senses.example: They let the flat to two students.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把公寓租给两名学生。
senses.why: Use is granted for a price, so permission extends to property.
senses.whyCN: 使用权被有偿授予，允许便延伸到房产。

senses.title: To allow through
senses.definition: to allow someone or something to pass or enter
senses.definitionCN: 允许人或物通过或进入
senses.example: The guard let the trucks through.
senses.exampleCN: 卫兵放行了卡车。
senses.why: A barrier lowers and traffic flows: letting is opening the way.
senses.whyCN: 栏杆抬起，车流通过：放行就是开路。

senses.title: To release or stop holding
senses.definition: to stop holding or confining something
senses.definitionCN: 停止握住或关住某物
senses.example: Let go of the rope slowly.
senses.exampleCN: 慢慢松开绳子。
senses.why: The grip opens and the thing is free, the plainest picture of permission.
senses.whyCN: 松手即自由，这是「允许」最直白的画面。

senses.title: To become weaker (let up)
senses.definition: to become less strong or stop, as rain or effort
senses.definitionCN: （雨势或努力）变弱或停止
senses.example: The rain finally let up at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 雨到中午终于小了。
senses.why: Pressure relaxes as if it were a hand that stops gripping.
senses.whyCN: 压力松弛，仿佛一只不再紧握的手。

intro.en: Let comes from Old English laetan "to allow, leave", from Germanic laetan, from a root meaning "to leave, let go"; the rental sense grew from granting use.
intro.cn: let 来自古英语 laetan「允许、留下」，出自日耳曼语 laetan，词根意为「离开、放开」；出租义由「授以使用权」发展而来。

items.en: Old English laetan meant 'to allow, let go, leave', already covering release and permission.
items.cn: 古英语 laetan 意为「允许、放开、留下」，已含释放与许可两义。

items.en: Germanic laetan ties the verb to a root of leaving and loosening, kin to the family of late and last.
items.cn: 日耳曼语 laetan 把动词系于「离开、松弛」词根，与 late、last 词族有亲缘。

items.en: In Middle English let developed the legal rental sense as land tenure spread.
items.cn: 中古英语随土地租佃普及，let 发展出法定的出租义。

items.en: Modern English kept the imperative let for suggestions, and tennis borrowed let for a replayed serve.
items.cn: 现代英语保留祈使 let 用于建议；网球借 let 指「擦网球重发」。

items.en: Norse influence may have reinforced the letting and hindering shades in northern dialects.
items.cn: 诺斯语影响可能强化了北方方言里「允许」与「妨碍」的色彩。

note.en: Group one flags look-alikes; group two lists permission and loosening words.
note.cn: 第一组标出形近词；第二组列出许可与松放之词。

entries.definition: After the expected time; shares three letters, a different root.
entries.definitionCN: 迟于预期；共享三字母，词根不同。

entries.definition: The limb; one letter off, unrelated.
entries.definitionCN: 腿；差一字母，无关。

entries.definition: The business or act of renting out.
entries.definitionCN: 出租的业务或行为。

entries.definition: To give permission, often by rule; let is closer and shorter.
entries.definitionCN: （常依规则）允许；let 更近身简短。

entries.definition: To allow officially, often with a document.
entries.definitionCN: 正式许可，常涉文件。

entries.definition: To let go of something held or confined.
entries.definitionCN: 松开被握或被关之物。

entries.definition: To pay for use; the user\u2019s side of letting.
entries.definitionCN: 付费使用；出租中使用者的一侧。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the native root and fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用本族词根与固定搭配。

normal.en: Old English laetan meant allow and let go.
normal.cn: 古英语 laetan 意为允许、放开。

normal.en: Kin words: late, last, loose — the family of leaving and slowing.
normal.cn: 亲族词：late、last、loose——「离开、放缓」词族。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: let go, let down, let in, let alone, let up.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：放开、使失望、放进、更不用说、减弱。

normal.en: British to let signs mean the flat is for rent.
normal.cn: 英式 to let 标牌意为房屋招租。

normal.en: Past forms: let, let, letting — the word never changes shape.
normal.cn: 词形：let、let、letting——从不变形。

abstract.en: Picture a gate swinging open because the hand stops pushing back.
abstract.cn: 想象手不再抵着，门自己荡开。

abstract.en: Picture rain easing until the umbrella folds shut.
abstract.cn: 想象雨渐弱，伞终于收拢。

abstract.en: Picture a held bird freed when fingers uncurl.
abstract.cn: 想象手指张开，握着的鸟飞走。

examples.en: Let the dough rest before you roll it.
examples.cn: 擀面之前先让面团醒一醒。

examples.en: The flat is let for five hundred a month.
examples.cn: 这套公寓月租五百。

examples.en: Don\u2019t let the noise upset you.
examples.cn: 别让噪声搅了你的心情。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「勒特」——勒住的手忽然放开 → 让；允许

root: 古英语 laetan「允许、放开」，出自日耳曼语 laetan，与「离开、松弛」词根相关；与 late、last 有亲缘关系。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses all rest on one loosened grip: permission, suggestion, rental, passage, release, and easing pressure.
sensesIntro.cn: 六个义项都建立在松开的手上：许可、建议、出租、放行、释放与压力放缓。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a loosened grip that opens the way.
core.cn: 核心意象：松开的手让出道路。

branches.en: SAYING YES: permission and the shared-action suggestion.
branches.cn: 说「好」：许可与共同行动的提议。

branches.en: GRANTED USE: property allowed at a price.
branches.cn: 授以使用：房产有偿获准。

branches.en: OPEN THE GATE: people and trucks pass through.
branches.cn: 开门放行：人与卡车通过。

branches.en: RELEASED: held things fly free.
branches.cn: 释放：被握之物得自由。

branches.en: EASING OFF: pressure and rain let up like a relaxing hand.
branches.cn: 放缓：压力与雨势像放松的手一样停歇。

intro.en: Let is a short native verb with no prefixes; compounds and idioms do the word-building.
intro.cn: let 是无前缀的短小本族动词；构词靠复合与习语。

latinIntro.en: No established Latin cognate exists, so the Latin section stays empty; the items show the native family.
latinIntro.cn: 没有确证的拉丁同族词，拉丁部分留空；条目展示本族词族。

items.example: The verb is native to English.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是英语本族的。

items.example: A cousin from the same root family.
British to let signs use it.
items.exampleCN: 英式 to let 标牌用之。

items.example: He can\u2019t walk, let alone run.
The storm let up at last.

definition_zh: 信；字母；字母（印刷体）
definition_en: a written message sent to someone; a symbol of an alphabet; the precise printed form of a text
core_image: 一张折起的纸，从一只手交到另一只手
scene: 寄宿学校周末，传达室排起长队取信。Every letter in this word is silent except one.
sceneCN: 这里 letter 是「信件」（第 1 个义项：写给某人的信）；句意为这个词里除一个字母外都不发音（示意）。

pos.zh: 用字母标写；在……上印字母

collocations.zh: 不折不扣地；严格按照字面

derivatives.zh: letter 加 -ing 名词化，指「印刷字体；题字」
letter 与 box 合成，指「信箱」
letter 与 head 合成，指「信头；信笺抬头」

senses.title: A written message
senses.definition: a written or printed message sent to someone, usually by post
senses.definitionCN: 写好寄出的书面消息，通常经邮局
senses.example: He wrote a long letter to his aunt.
senses.exampleCN: 他给姑妈写了一封长信。
senses.why: The paper carries words from one hand to another; the message travels like the paper itself.
senses.whyCN: 纸把话从一只手带到另一只手；消息随纸而行。

senses.title: A symbol of an alphabet
senses.definition: one of the written symbols of an alphabet
senses.definitionCN: 字母表的书写符号之一
senses.example: Print your name in capital letters.
senses.exampleCN: 用大写字母印出你的名字。
senses.why: Alphabet marks are the smallest units a letter can be, so the word covers them too.
senses.whyCN: 字母标记是 letter 能指的最小单位，一词便涵盖二者。

senses.title: The literal wording
senses.titleCN: 字面；精确字句（to the letter）
senses.definition: the exact wording, as followed in to the letter
senses.definitionCN: 精确的文字表述，如 to the letter
senses.example: The soldiers followed orders to the letter.
senses.exampleCN: 士兵们不折不扣地执行命令。
senses.why: Following every symbol is following the text to its very letters.
senses.whyCN: 逐个符号都照办，就是把文本执行到每个字。

senses.title: To mark with letters
senses.definition: to write, print or mark letters on something
senses.definitionCN: 在某物上写、印或标字母
senses.example: The gate was lettered with the school name.
senses.exampleCN: 大门上印着校名的字母。
senses.why: The noun turned verb: putting letters onto a surface.
senses.whyCN: 名词转动词：把字母放到表面上。

senses.title: Literature or learning (letters)
senses.definition: literature or written culture, as in a man of letters
senses.definitionCN: 文学或书写文化，如 man of letters
senses.example: She devoted her life to letters.
senses.exampleCN: 她毕生献身文学。
senses.why: The whole world of writing is built of letters, so writing itself took the plural name.
senses.whyCN: 整个书写世界由字母筑成，书写本身便承袭复数之名。

senses.title: A sports letter
senses.definition: a university or school initial awarded for sports achievement
senses.definitionCN: 美式学校发给体育达标的校名首字母徽章
senses.example: He won his letter in swimming.
senses.exampleCN: 他因游泳获得了校队字母徽章。
senses.why: The initial of the school stitched on a jacket marks the honour, so the symbol became a prize.
senses.whyCN: 缝在夹克上的校名首字母标记荣誉，符号便成了奖赏。

intro.en: Letter comes from Old French lettre, from Latin littera "a written character, an epistle", probably from a word for a smoothing board used in writing.
intro.cn: letter 来自古法语 lettre，出自拉丁语 littera「文字符号、书信」，可能源自书写时所用「刮平木板」一词。

items.en: Latin littera meant both a written character and a document; the plural litterae meant an epistle.
items.cn: 拉丁语 littera 既指书写符号也指文书；复数 litterae 指书信。

items.en: Source uncertain (root only): the link to linere 'to smear' or to a writing tablet is debated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅词根）：与 linere「涂抹」或书写板的联系存在争议。

items.en: Old French lettre carried the word into medieval English with its senses intact.
items.cn: 古法语 lettre 把词连同各义项带入中古英语。

items.en: Middle English widened letter to the alphabet symbol and the message alike.
items.cn: 中古英语把 letter 同时扩到字母符号与书信。

items.en: Modern English added the printed-word sense, the verb, and the sports badge in America.
items.cn: 现代英语新增印刷字面义、动词用法与美国的体育徽章义。

note.en: Group one flags look-alikes; group two lists writing and messaging words.
note.cn: 第一组标出形近词；第二组列出书写与通信之词。

entries.definition: Rubbish or a bed of straw; shares the Latin root but split off long ago.
entries.definitionCN: 垃圾或垫草；同出拉丁词根但早已分流。

entries.definition: Printed or drawn letters as decoration.
entries.definitionCN: 作为装饰的印刷或描画字母。

entries.definition: Able to read and write, from the same Latin family.
entries.definitionCN: 能读写的，出自同一拉丁词族。

entries.definition: A short informal message; a letter is longer and formal.
entries.definitionCN: 简短非正式的便条；letter 更长更正式。

entries.definition: A printed symbol; letters and numbers are characters.
entries.definitionCN: 印刷符号；字母数字皆属字符。

entries.definition: A formal or biblical letter.
entries.definitionCN: 正式或圣经体书信。

entries.definition: The whole postal system and its items.
entries.definitionCN: 邮政系统及其邮件整体。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the Latin root and real phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用拉丁词根与真实短语。

normal.en: Latin littera meant a written character and a letter alike.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 littera 既指文字符号也指书信。

normal.en: Cousins: literate, literature, obliterate.
normal.cn: 同族词：literate、literature、obliterate。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: to the letter, capital letter, letter box.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：不折不扣地、大写字母、信箱。

normal.en: A man of letters means a scholar of writing.
normal.cn: man of letters 指文人学者。

normal.en: The verb lettering marks names on gates and boats.
normal.cn: 动词 lettering 用于在门、船上描字。

abstract.en: Picture an envelope crossing a town in one morning.
abstract.cn: 想象一封信一个清晨横穿全城。

abstract.en: Picture huge painted letters on a shopfront.
abstract.cn: 想象店面墙上巨大的描画字母。

abstract.en: Picture a jacket with one proud initial stitched on it.
abstract.cn: 想象夹克上缝着一个骄傲的首字母。

examples.en: A letter from home arrived after the exam.
examples.cn: 考试后家里的信到了。

examples.en: Fill the form in block letters.
examples.cn: 请用正体大写字母填表。

examples.en: Follow the recipe to the letter.
examples.cn: 严格照食谱一步步来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「来特」——来信带来特别的字 → 信；字母

root: 拉丁语 littera「文字符号、书信」（可能源自书写用刮板一词，存疑）→ 古法语 lettre → 英语 letter；与 literate、literature 同族。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses run from the smallest symbol to the whole world of writing: character, message, exact wording, marking, literature, and a stitched badge.
sensesIntro.cn: 六个义项从最小符号到整个书写世界：字符、书信、精确字句、标写、文学与缝制的徽章。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a folded paper and the marks that fill it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张折起的纸与铺满其上的符号。

branches.en: THE MESSAGE: the paper travels with words inside.
branches.cn: 信息：纸载着话同行。

branches.en: THE MARKS: single symbols and their exact sequence.
branches.cn: 符号：单个字符及其精确序列。

branches.en: PUTTING MARKS ON: the noun turned into a verb of printing.
branches.cn: 落符号：名词转为印刷动词。

branches.en: WRITING WORLD: literature, and the initial worn as honour.
branches.cn: 书写世界：文学，以及佩作荣誉的首字母。

branches.en: THE PIVOT: both paper and marks share one word.
branches.cn: 轴心：纸与符号共用一词。

intro.en: Letter is a borrowed noun with no prefixes of its own; compounds and native suffixes build the family.
intro.cn: letter 是无前缀的外来名词；词族靠复合与本族后缀构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root littera gives true cousins, listed in the Latin entries; the items also show English suffix work.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 littera 提供真正的同族词，列入拉丁条目；条目同时展示英语后缀加工。

items.exampleCN: 它把 letter 变成 lettering。

definition_zh: 水平面；水平；级别；平整的；夷平
definition_en: a flat surface or height; a position in a scale; flat and even; to flatten completely
core_image: 水面静止时那道绝对平直的线
scene: 雨停之后，湖面平得像一面镜子。Pass the exam and you reach the next level.
sceneCN: 这里 level 是「级别」（第 3 个义项：等级、级别）；句意为通过考试就能升到下一级。

derivatives.zh: level 加 -ly，指「平稳地；平静地」
level 与 head 合成，指「头脑冷静的」

senses.title: A flat, even surface or line
senses.definition: a surface or line that is flat and even all across
senses.definitionCN: 整体平整的表面或线条
senses.example: The table top is perfectly level.
senses.exampleCN: 桌面完全水平。
senses.why: The picture is the still line of water: nothing tilts, nothing dips.
senses.whyCN: 画面是静止的水线：无倾斜、无低垂。

senses.title: A height measured against a standard
senses.definition: a height or position measured from a reference point
senses.definitionCN: 相对于基准的高度或位置
senses.example: The flood rose above ground level.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水涨过了地面高度。
senses.why: Measuring compares the water line to everything else, so height borrows the flat line.
senses.whyCN: 测量把水线与其他一切相比，高度便借用这条平线。

senses.title: A position in a scale
senses.definition: a rank or stage in a series of amounts or abilities
senses.definitionCN: 数量或能力序列中的等级或阶段
senses.example: Pass the exam and you reach the next level.
senses.exampleCN: 通过考试就能升到下一级。
senses.why: A scale is drawn as flat steps, each step one level of the ladder.
senses.whyCN: 标尺被画成平直的阶梯，每阶即一级。

senses.title: An amount or concentration
senses.definition: an amount or degree of something present at a time
senses.definitionCN: 某物在某时的数量或程度
senses.example: Noise levels drop at night.
senses.exampleCN: 夜间噪声水平下降。
senses.why: The reading is a height on the gauge, so amounts climb and fall like water.
senses.whyCN: 读数是仪表上的高度，数量如水位涨落。

senses.title: Flat and even; fair
senses.definition: flat, even, or equal in position or treatment
senses.definitionCN: 平的、等高的，或待遇对等的
senses.example: The two teams played on a level field.
senses.exampleCN: 两队曾在平整的场地上比赛。
senses.why: Even ground gives no one an advantage, and fairness keeps the same image.
senses.whyCN: 平地不偏向任何人，公平沿用同一意象。

senses.title: To flatten or destroy
senses.definition: to make flat, especially by demolishing
senses.definitionCN: 使平坦，尤指拆除推平
senses.example: The quake levelled whole streets.
senses.exampleCN: 地震把整条街道夷为平地。
senses.why: Building up in reverse is tearing down to the flat line.
senses.whyCN: 逆向施工就是把一切拉回水平线。

senses.title: To become steady (level off)
senses.definition: to stop rising or falling and become steady
senses.definitionCN: 停止升降趋于平稳
senses.example: Prices levelled off after the holiday.
senses.exampleCN: 假日后价格趋稳。
senses.why: The rising line finally lies flat, like water finding its own level.
senses.whyCN: 上升的线最终躺平，如水归于水平。

intro.en: Level comes from Old French nivel, from Latin libella, a diminutive of libra "scales, balance"; the flat line of a balance gave the flat surface its name.
intro.cn: level 来自古法语 nivel，出自拉丁语 libella（libra「天平、秤」的指小词）；天平的平直横线给了平面这个名字。

items.en: Latin libra meant scales or balance, the tool whose beam stays flat.
items.cn: 拉丁语 libra 指天平或秤，其横梁保持平直。

items.en: Latin libella, a small balance, named the carpenter\u0027s tool for checking flatness.
items.cn: 拉丁语 libella（小天平）命名了木工测量平直的工具。

items.en: Old French nivel kept the tool sense and the flatness sense together.
items.cn: 古法语 nivel 同时保留工具义与平坦义。

items.en: Middle English spread level to heights, scales of rank, and fairness.
items.cn: 中古英语把 level 扩展到高度、等级序列与公平。

items.en: Modern English added the verb of flattening and the steady-price sense level off.
items.cn: 现代英语新增夷平动词与 level off 价格趋稳义。

entries.definitionCN: 撬杠；出自拉丁语 levare「抬起」，词根不同。

entries.definition: In a calm, even manner.
entries.definitionCN: 平稳地；平静地。

entries.definition: The Latin scales sign and constellation.
entries.definitionCN: 拉丁天平符号与星座名。

entries.definition: Smooth and even; level stresses the horizontal line.
entries.definitionCN: 平而光滑；level 强调水平线。

entries.definition: A step in a scale or school year.
entries.definitionCN: 等级或年级中的一级。

entries.definition: A position in a hierarchy.
entries.definitionCN: 层级中的位置。

entries.definition: To tear down buildings; matches the flattening verb.
entries.definitionCN: 拆除建筑；对应夷平义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the Latin balance and real phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用拉丁天平与真实短语。

normal.en: Latin libra, the scales, is the sign of balance in the zodiac.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 libra（天平）是黄道十二宫的天秤座。

normal.en: The tool for checking flatness is called a level.
normal.cn: 检验平直的工具就叫 level（水平仪）。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: level off, sea level, level with someone.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：趋稳、海平面、坦率相告。

normal.en: British doubles the l: levelled, levelling.
normal.cn: 英式双写 l：levelled、levelling。

normal.en: A level playing field means fair conditions for all.
normal.cn: level playing field 指对所有人公平的条件。

abstract.en: Picture the mirror-flat lake after rain.
abstract.cn: 想象雨后镜面般平的湖。

abstract.en: Picture wrecking balls leaving nothing but a flat lot.
abstract.cn: 想象破碎球过后只剩一片平地。

abstract.en: Picture a price line that stops climbing and lies flat.
abstract.cn: 想象价格曲线停止爬升、躺平不动。

examples.en: Water always finds its own level.
examples.cn: 水总会找到自己的水平面。

examples.en: Her French is at an advanced level.
examples.cn: 她的法语已达高级水平。

examples.en: The old factory was levelled last year.
examples.cn: 旧工厂去年被夷平了。

sensesIntro.en: Seven senses all lean on one flat line: surfaces, measured heights, scale steps, readings, fairness, flattening, and steadying prices.
sensesIntro.cn: 七个义项都倚仗同一条平线：平面、量得的高度、等级阶梯、读数、公平、夷平与价格趋稳。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the unchanging flat line of still water.

branches.en: THE LINE AND ITS HEIGHT: flat surfaces and heights measured from them.
branches.cn: 线与高度：平面及以其为基准的高度。

branches.cn: 标尺：级别与读数爬同一架梯子。

branches.en: EVEN TREATMENT: fairness keeps the ground equal.
branches.cn: 对等对待：公平让地面均等。

branches.en: TEARING DOWN: destruction reduces all to the flat line.
branches.cn: 推倒：破坏把一切拉回平线。

branches.en: FINDING REST: lines and prices settle level at last.
branches.cn: 归于平静：曲线与价格最终持稳。

definition_zh: 图书馆；藏书；书房；藏书楼
definition_en: a building or room holding a collection of books for reading or borrowing; a private collection of books
core_image: 一屋子书架，安静得能听见翻页声
scene: 考试周，大学图书馆的座位要早起去占。The library closes at ten on weekdays.
sceneCN: 这里 library 是「藏书借阅之所」（第 1 个义项：图书馆）；句意为图书馆工作日十点闭馆。

derivatives.zh: library 加指人后缀 -arian，指「图书馆管理员」
与 library 同出拉丁 liber 词族，指「（歌剧）剧本」

senses.title: A place of books for the public
senses.definition: a building or room with books kept for reading or borrowing
senses.definitionCN: 收藏书籍供阅读或借阅的建筑或房间
senses.example: The library closes at ten on weekdays.
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆工作日十点闭馆。
senses.why: The Latin liber means book, so a library is a room defined by books.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 liber 意为书，图书馆便是以书定义的房间。

senses.title: A private collection of books
senses.definition: a person\u0027s or institution\u0027s collection of books
senses.definitionCN: 个人或机构收藏的书籍
senses.example: His library holds every edition of the novel.
senses.exampleCN: 他的藏书收齐了这部小说的每个版本。
senses.why: Ownership gathers books into one place, and the gathered pile keeps the same name.
senses.whyCN: 所有权把书聚到一处，聚成的书堆沿用同名。

senses.title: A room in a private house
senses.definition: a room in a house used for books and reading
senses.definitionCN: 住宅中用于藏书与阅读的房间
senses.example: He dozes off in the library after dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 晚饭后他在书房打盹。
senses.why: The private shelf needs a room, and the room inherits the book name.
senses.whyCN: 私人的书架需要一间屋，屋子便继承了书的名字。

senses.title: A set of records or data
senses.definition: an organized collection of records, films or software
senses.definitionCN: 唱片、影片或程序的系统收藏
senses.example: The film library holds two thousand titles.
senses.exampleCN: 影片库藏有两千部片名。
senses.why: Whatever is collected and shelved can take the book-room name.
senses.whyCN: 凡被收藏上架之物都可沿用书屋之名。

senses.title: A series of standard works
senses.definition: a published series of books with a common format
senses.definitionCN: 同一版式的成套出版物
senses.example: The classics library fills one shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 这套古典文库占满一格书架。
senses.why: A uniform shelf of editions looks like one collected library.
senses.whyCN: 版式统一的整架书看起来就像一座藏书。

intro.en: Library comes from Old French librarie, from Medieval Latin libraria (biblioteca) 'bookshop', from Latin liber 'book, bark of a tree'.
intro.cn: library 来自古法语 librarie，出自中世纪拉丁语 libraria (biblioteca)「书店」，词根是拉丁语 liber「书、树皮」。

items.en: Latin liber originally meant the inner bark of a tree, which early writers used as a surface.
items.cn: 拉丁语 liber 本指树的内皮，早期书写者以之为书写面。

items.en: Liber came to mean a written book, since bark scrolls became bound volumes.
items.cn: liber 转指成书，因为树皮卷演变为装订册。

items.en: Medieval Latin libraria meant a bookshop or book-room.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 libraria 指书店或藏书之屋。

items.en: Old French librarie carried the word into English.
items.cn: 古法语 librarie 把词带入英语。

items.en: Modern English widened library to private rooms, collections and even software archives.
items.cn: 现代英语把 library 扩展到私人书房、收藏乃至软件资料库。

note.en: Group one flags look-alikes; group two lists book and collection words.
note.cn: 第一组标出形近词；第二组列出书籍与收藏之词。

entries.definition: The keeper of a library.
entries.definitionCN: 图书馆的管理者。

entries.definition: An opera text, from the same Latin liber.
entries.definitionCN: 歌剧脚本，同出拉丁 liber。

entries.definition: From the littera family, not liber; the two roots are often confused.
entries.definitionCN: 出自 littera 词族而非 liber；两词根常被混淆。

entries.definition: A store of records rather than books.
entries.definitionCN: 存档之所，重记录而非图书。

entries.definition: Just the furniture, not the institution.
entries.definitionCN: 只是家具，不是机构。

entries.definition: Any gathered set; library implies books and use.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指收集；library 特指书与使用。

entries.definition: Where books are sold, from the same Medieval Latin sense.
entries.definitionCN: 卖书之处，同出中世纪拉丁词义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the bark-to-book trail and real phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用「树皮到书」的词路及真实短语。

normal.cn: 拉丁语 liber 最初指树皮——最早的书写面。

normal.cn: 同族词：librarian、libretto。

abstract.en: Picture strips of bark drying in the sun, waiting for words.
abstract.cn: 想象一条条树皮晒在太阳下，等着字迹。

abstract.en: Picture one quiet room where every shelf hums with pages.
abstract.cn: 想象一间静室，每格书架都翻动如蜂鸣。

abstract.en: Picture a single shelf wearing one uniform row of spines.
abstract.cn: 想象一格书架上书脊齐整如队列。

examples.en: You can borrow six books with one library card.
examples.cn: 一张借书证可借六本书。

examples.en: Her private library runs to five thousand volumes.
examples.cn: 她的私人藏书多达五千卷。

examples.en: The village library doubles as a meeting room.
examples.cn: 村图书馆兼作会议室。

sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项随书而聚：公共殿堂、私人书架、家中书房、资料库与统一丛书。

branches.cn: 殿堂：供阅读借阅的公共建筑。

branches.en: THE GATHERED PILE: private collections and uniform series.
branches.cn: 聚成的书堆：私人收藏与统一丛书。

branches.en: THE HOME SHELF: a room of one\u0027s own books.
branches.cn: 家中书架：放自己书的房间。

branches.en: MODERN SHELVES: records, films and code archived like books.

definition_zh: 躺；平卧；位于；撒谎；谎言
definition_en: to be in a flat resting position; to be situated; to say something untrue; an untrue statement
core_image: 身体放平，静卧不动；或嘴一张，假话滑出
scene: 午后阳台，猫在毯子上翻了个身。The old town lies beside a quiet river.
sceneCN: 这里 lie 是「位于」（第 2 个义项：坐落、位于）；句意为古城坐落在一条安静的河边。

derivatives.zh: lie 加指人后缀 -ar，指「说谎的人」
lie 加 -ing，指「说谎的；躺卧的」

senses.title: To be in a flat resting position
senses.definition: to put your body flat on a surface to rest
senses.definitionCN: 把身体平放在一个面上休息
senses.example: The cat lies on the warm mat all afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 猫整个下午都躺在暖垫上。
senses.why: A body laid out flat is the plain physical picture.
senses.whyCN: 平放的身体是最直白的画面。

senses.title: To be situated
senses.definition: to be in a particular place or position
senses.definitionCN: 处于某地或某位置
senses.example: The old town lies beside a quiet river.
senses.exampleCN: 古城坐落在安静的河边。
senses.why: A place 'rests' where it is, so the body word extends to geography.
senses.whyCN: 地方「安卧」于其所在，身体之词便延伸到地理。

senses.title: To stay or remain in a state
senses.definition: to remain in a specified condition
senses.definitionCN: 保持于特定状态
senses.example: The papers lay untouched for a week.
senses.exampleCN: 文件一周没人碰。
senses.why: What lies somewhere also lies in some state; position and condition share the verb.
senses.whyCN: 躺于某处也即处于某状态，位置与状态共用此动词。

senses.title: To say something untrue
senses.definition: to make a false statement on purpose
senses.definitionCN: 故意作虚假陈述
senses.example: He lied about his age to join.
senses.exampleCN: 他谎报年龄报名。
senses.why: The mouth builds a false picture; a different verb grew beside the lying-down one.
senses.whyCN: 嘴构建假象；这个词与「躺卧」的词是并肩长成的另一个词。

senses.title: An untrue statement
senses.definition: something said that is known to be false
senses.definitionCN: 明知不实而言之事
senses.example: That story is a bare-faced lie.
senses.exampleCN: 那个说法是彻头彻尾的谎言。
senses.why: The false statement freezes into a noun anyone can point at.
senses.whyCN: 假陈述凝固成名词，人人可以指认。

senses.title: To be about to happen (lie ahead)
senses.definition: to be waiting in the future
senses.definitionCN: 在将来等待
senses.example: Greater tests lie ahead of us.
senses.exampleCN: 更大的考验在前方等着我们。
senses.why: The future stretches out before you like a road you have not walked.
senses.whyCN: 未来像未走的路在你面前铺开。

senses.title: To be buried or at rest (lie)
senses.definition: to be buried in a grave or resting place
senses.definitionCN: 安葬于墓穴或安息之所
senses.example: Her ashes lie beneath the old oak.
senses.exampleCN: 她的骨灰安放在老橡树下。
senses.why: Final rest is the last lying down, the verb\u0027s quietest use.
senses.whyCN: 最终安息是最后一次躺下，动词最安静的用法。

intro.en: Two verbs share the spelling lie. The posture word comes from Old English licgan, from Germanic ligan 'to lie down'; the falsehood word comes from Old English leogan 'to tell lies', from a root meaning 'to lie, be false'.
intro.cn: 两个动词共用拼写 lie。姿态词来自古英语 licgan，出自日耳曼语 ligan「躺下」；谎言词来自古英语 leogan「说谎」，词根意为「不实」。

items.en: Old English licgan meant 'to lie, be situated', the posture verb used across English ever since.
items.cn: 古英语 licgan 意为「躺、位于」，姿态动词沿用至今。

items.en: Germanic ligan is behind the posture verb, kin to German liegen and Dutch liggen.
items.cn: 日耳曼语 ligan 是姿态动词的来源，与德语 liegen、荷兰语 liggen 同族。

items.en: Old English leogan meant 'to tell falsehoods', a separate verb with its own root.
items.cn: 古英语 leogan 意为「说谎」，是与姿态词无关的独立动词。

items.en: The falsehood root spread through Germanic, giving German lugen 'to peer, spy' in some dialects.
items.cn: 谎言词根遍布日耳曼语族，某些方言给出德语 lugen「窥视」。

items.en: In Middle English the two verbs kept distinct past forms while sharing one spelling.
items.cn: 中古英语里两动词过去式分立，仅共享一个拼写。

note.en: Group one flags the famous confusions; group two lists rest and falsehood words.
note.cn: 第一组标出著名易混词；第二组列出休憩与谎言词。

entries.definition: To put something down; it needs an object, while lie does not.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物放下；需宾语，lie 不需。

entries.definition: One who tells lies.
entries.definitionCN: 说谎的人。

entries.definition: French word for place, as in in lieu of; unrelated root.
entries.definitionCN: 法语「地方」，如 in lieu of；词根无关。

entries.definition: To relax lying down or sit still.
entries.definitionCN: 躺下或静坐放松。

entries.definition: To change facts dishonestly; stronger and more official than lie.
entries.definitionCN: 不实改动事实；比 lie 更强更正式。

entries.definition: To lean back in a resting position.
entries.definitionCN: 后倚而卧。

entries.definition: A small harmless lie.
entries.definitionCN: 无伤大雅的小谎。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the two roots and the famous grammar trap.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用两个词根与著名语法陷阱。

normal.en: Posture lie: lie, lay, lain — no object needed.
normal.cn: 姿态 lie：lie、lay、lain——不需要宾语。

normal.en: Falsehood lie: lie, lied, lied — regular.
normal.cn: 谎言 lie：lie、lied、lied——规则变化。

normal.en: You lay the book (put it); you lie on the bed (rest).
normal.cn: lay 是放书，lie 是躺床。

normal.en: Idioms: lie down, lie in, white lie, lie ahead.
normal.cn: 习语：躺下、睡懒觉、善意的谎言、即将来临。

normal.en: Liar is the person; lying covers both senses as an adjective.
normal.cn: liar 是说谎者；lying 作形容词可指两种义。

abstract.en: Picture a cat stretched flat in one sunbeam.
abstract.cn: 想象一只猫摊平在阳光里。

abstract.en: Picture a map where towns rest beside rivers.
abstract.cn: 想象地图上城镇安卧河畔。

abstract.en: Picture a mask slipping off a smiling face.
abstract.cn: 想象面具从笑脸滑落。

examples.en: Lie still and the room stops spinning.
examples.cn: 躺稳别动，房间就不转了。

examples.en: He lied once and spent a year earning trust back.
examples.cn: 他说了一次谎，花了一年赢回信任。

examples.en: Adventure lies just beyond the hills.
examples.cn: 冒险就在山那边。

sensesIntro.en: Seven senses run on two separate rails: a body at rest — lying, situated, in a state, waiting ahead, buried — and a mouth astray — lying and its noun.
sensesIntro.cn: 七个义项沿两条轨道：静卧之身——躺、位于、处于、在前方等待、安葬——与失口之嘴——说谎及其名词。

core.cn: 核心意象：放平的身体；偏离真相的嘴。

branches.en: THE FLAT BODY: resting now and resting forever.
branches.cn: 平放的身体：此刻安卧与永久安息。

branches.en: THE PLACE AND ITS STATE: where things lie and how they lie.
branches.cn: 位置与状态：物卧何处、处于何种状态。

branches.en: THE ROAD AHEAD: the future lies like unwalked ground.
branches.cn: 前方之路：未来如未踏之地铺展。

branches.en: THE OTHER RAIL: false words and the noun they form.
branches.cn: 另一条轨道：假话与其凝成的名词。

branches.en: THE PIVOT: stillness under both readings.
branches.cn: 轴心：两种读法共享「静止」。

definition_zh: 生命；生活；一生；寿命；活力
definition_en: the state of being alive; the way someone lives; the period from birth to death; energy and liveliness
core_image: 一株从破土、开花到枯萎的完整植物，一段有始有终的时间
scene: 产房外，祖父抱着刚出生的婴儿老泪纵横。Some people find new life in a strange city.
sceneCN: 这里 life 是「生活方式」（第 2 个义项：生活）；句意为有些人在陌生城市里找到新的生活。

derivatives.zh: life 与 time 合成，指「一生；终身期间」
life 与 long 合成，指「终身的；毕生的」
life 加 -less，指「无生命的；死气沉沉的」

senses.title: The state of being alive
senses.definition: the quality that distinguishes living things from dead matter
senses.definitionCN: 把生物与死物区分开来的性质
senses.example: Doctors fought all night to save the patient\u0027s life.
senses.exampleCN: 医生整夜奋战抢救病人性命。
senses.why: Breath, growth and repair mark the living from the stone; the word names that difference.
senses.whyCN: 呼吸、生长与修复区分生命与石头，这个词就命名这种差异。

senses.title: The way a person lives
senses.definition: the activities, work and pleasures of a person or group
senses.definitionCN: 个人或群体的活动、工作与乐趣
senses.example: Some people find new life in a strange city.
senses.exampleCN: 有些人在陌生城市里找到新的生活。
senses.why: Being alive happens in a certain way, so the state became the manner.
senses.whyCN: 活着总是以某种方式进行，状态于是变成了方式。

senses.title: The period from birth to death
senses.definition: the time between birth and death
senses.definitionCN: 从出生到死亡之间的时间
senses.example: She spent her life teaching in the mountains.
senses.exampleCN: 她一生都在山里教书。
senses.why: A life can be counted in years, so the state turned into a length of time.
senses.whyCN: 生命可以用年头计，状态于是变成时间长度。

senses.title: Liveliness and energy
senses.definition: energy, excitement or liveliness
senses.definitionCN: 精力、兴奋或生气
senses.example: The party suddenly came to life after midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 午夜后派对突然热闹起来。
senses.why: Full life shows as movement and brightness, so energy borrows the name.
senses.whyCN: 充沛的生命表现为活动与光亮，活力便借用了这个名字。

senses.title: The duration of something useful
senses.definition: how long a machine, product or organization works
senses.definitionCN: 机器、产品或机构可用多久
senses.example: The battery has a life of five years.
senses.exampleCN: 这块电池的寿命是五年。
senses.why: Machines live and die like bodies, so the word spread to objects.
senses.whyCN: 机器像身体一样生灭，词便扩及器物。

senses.title: Living things collectively
senses.definition: living creatures and plants considered as a whole
senses.definitionCN: 作为整体来看的动植物
senses.example: Ocean life is still largely unknown.
senses.exampleCN: 海洋生物仍大多不为人知。
senses.why: All living things together form one subject, the science of life.
senses.whyCN: 一切生物合在一起成为一个主题——生命科学。

senses.title: A biography
senses.definition: a written account of a person\u0027s life
senses.definitionCN: 记述某人一生的文字
senses.example: He wrote a life of the poet.
senses.exampleCN: 他写了一部诗人传记。
senses.why: A whole span of years fills a book, so the time became the story.
senses.whyCN: 一生岁月填满一本书，时间于是变成故事。

intro.en: Life comes from Old English lif, from Germanic roots of remaining and continuing; the same family gives live and the leave-behind words.
intro.cn: life 来自古英语 lif，出自日耳曼语「留存、延续」词根；live 与「留下」诸词同出此族。

items.en: Old English lif meant 'life', and the verb libban 'to live' grew beside it.
items.cn: 古英语 lif 意为「生命」，动词 libban「活着」在旁生长。

items.en: Germanic roots of remaining and continuing lie behind the family: to live is to last.
items.cn: 「留存、延续」的日耳曼词根是词族的基础：活着即是延续。

items.en: In Middle English the plural lives settled, and 'life' came to mean a biography.
items.cn: 中古英语里复数 lives 固定下来，life 开始指传记。

items.en: Modern English widened life to machines, oceans and batteries.
items.cn: 现代英语把 life 扩展到机器、海洋与电池。

items.en: Source uncertain (root only): the trail beyond Germanic, perhaps meaning 'to remain', is debated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅词根）：日耳曼语之前或与「留存」相关的轨迹仍有争议。

note.en: Group one flags look-alikes; group two lists living and lasting words.
note.cn: 第一组标出形近词；第二组列出存活与延续之词。

entries.definition: To raise; shares three letters, unrelated root.
entries.definitionCN: 举起；共享三字母，词根无关。

entries.definition: The verb of the same family; life is its noun.
entries.definitionCN: 同族动词；life 是其名词。

entries.definition: The whole span of a life.
entries.definitionCN: 一生的全程。

entries.definition: Being, especially bare survival; more abstract than life.
entries.definitionCN: 存在，尤指勉强维持；比 life 更抽象。

entries.definition: A written life; matches the biography sense.
entries.definitionCN: 书面传记；对应传记义。

entries.definition: The way one earns a living.
entries.definitionCN: 谋生之道。

entries.definition: Energy and liveliness; matches the energy sense.
entries.definitionCN: 精力与生气；对应活力义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real family and fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实词族与固定搭配。

normal.en: Old English lif meant life; libban meant to live.
normal.cn: 古英语 lif 意为生命；libban 意为活着。

normal.en: Family: lives, lifetime, lifelong, lifeless.
normal.cn: 词族：lives、lifetime、lifelong、lifeless。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: daily life, come to life, in real life.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：日常生活、苏醒、在现实中。

normal.en: Batteries and machines have a life too.
normal.cn: 电池与机器也有「寿命」。

normal.en: A written life of someone is also called a life.
normal.cn: 记述某人一生的书也叫 a life。

abstract.en: Picture a seed cracking open under the soil.
abstract.cn: 想象一粒种子在土里破壳。

abstract.en: Picture an empty hall filling with music and people.
abstract.cn: 想象空旷大厅被音乐与人填满。

abstract.en: Picture a clock slowly winding down beside a machine.
abstract.cn: 想象机器旁的发条慢慢走完。

examples.en: Country life suits him better than the city.
examples.cn: 乡村生活比城市更适合他。

examples.en: The old town comes to life at festival time.
examples.cn: 节日期间老城生机盎然。

examples.en: She has spent her life collecting folk songs.
examples.cn: 她一生都在采集民歌。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「来夫」——来这世上，活成一夫当关的一生 → 生命；生活

root: 古英语 lif「生命」，出自日耳曼语「留存、延续」词根；与 live、德语 bleiben 词族有亲缘；更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Seven senses all grow from continuing: being alive, the way of it, the length of it, its brightness, the life of machines, all living things, and the written life.
sensesIntro.cn: 七个义项都从「延续」生长：活着本身、活的方式、活的长度、它的光亮、机器之寿、众生整体与书写的生平。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a span of time that keeps breathing.
core.cn: 核心意象：一段持续呼吸的时光。

branches.en: THE BARE STATE: the difference between stone and seed.
branches.cn: 裸状态：石头与种子的分界。

branches.en: THE MANNER: living takes a shape, daily or chosen.
branches.cn: 方式：生活有其形状——日常的或自选的。

branches.en: THE SPAN: years counted, then written into a book.
branches.cn: 全程：以年计，再写成书。

branches.en: BRIGHTNESS AND DURATION: party energy, battery years.
branches.cn: 光亮与时长：派对的生气、电池的年头。

branches.en: EVERYTHING ALIVE: the whole living world as one subject.
branches.cn: 众生：整个生命世界作为一个主题。

intro.en: Life is a native word with no prefixes; the family compounds with time, long and less.
intro.cn: life 是无前缀的本族词；词族与 time、long、less 复合。

definition_zh: 举起；抬高；提升（精神）；电梯；搭便车
definition_en: to raise something to a higher position; to raise one\u0027s spirits; a machine that carries people up a building; a free ride in a car
core_image: 双手把重物从地面托到空中
scene: 搬家日，他把纸箱从地板托过肩头。Could you give me a lift to the station?
sceneCN: 这里 lift 是名词「搭便车」（第 6 个义项：免费搭乘）；句意为能顺路捎我去车站吗。

collocations.zh: 让某人搭便车；鼓舞某人

derivatives.zh: lift 加施事后缀 -er，指「举重者；起重装置」
up 与 lift 合成，指「提升；鼓舞」
lift 与 off 合成，指「（火箭）发射升空」

senses.title: To raise to a higher position
senses.definition: to move something up to a higher place
senses.definitionCN: 把某物移到更高的位置
senses.example: She lifted the box onto the shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 她把箱子抬上架子。
senses.why: Gravity must be beaten for a moment, and the word pictures the upward push.
senses.whyCN: 必须短暂战胜重力，词画出了向上的托举。

senses.title: To raise emotions or spirits
senses.definition: to make someone feel happier or more hopeful
senses.definitionCN: 使人心更愉快、更有希望
senses.example: The news lifted everyone\u0027s mood.
senses.exampleCN: 消息让所有人的心情一振。
senses.why: Feelings rise like objects: joy lifts, sadness sinks.
senses.whyCN: 情绪如物体升降：喜升而忧沉。

senses.title: To remove or end
senses.definition: to officially remove a rule, block or restriction
senses.definitionCN: 正式取消规则、封锁或限制
senses.example: The city lifted the curfew.
senses.exampleCN: 城市解除了宵禁。
senses.why: Removing a block is lifting the weight that held things down.
senses.whyCN: 解除禁令就是抬起压着东西的重量。

senses.title: To carry people between floors
senses.definition: to move people between floors of a building, or the machine itself
senses.definitionCN: 在楼层间载运人，或指电梯本身
senses.example: Take the lift to the fifth floor.
senses.exampleCN: 乘电梯到五楼。
senses.why: The machine does the lifting for you, so it borrowed the verb as a name.
senses.whyCN: 机器替你完成「举」，便借动词作名字。

senses.title: A free ride in a car
senses.definition: a journey in someone else\u0027s car without payment
senses.definitionCN: 免费搭乘他人汽车
senses.example: He gave me a lift home in the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 雨天他捎我回家。
senses.why: The car "lifts" you along the road, so the ride took the name.
senses.whyCN: 汽车把你「抬」着沿路走，旅程便得了这个名。

senses.title: To steal or copy
senses.definition: to take words or ideas from somewhere and use them as one\u0027s own
senses.definitionCN: 把他处文字或点子拿来当作自己的
senses.example: Someone lifted two paragraphs from my draft.
senses.exampleCN: 有人从我草稿里抄了两段。
senses.why: Taking content is "lifting" it out of its place, and the shade is dishonest.
senses.whyCN: 把内容从原处「拿走」，色彩偏负面。

senses.title: Aircraft rising force
senses.definition: the upward force that keeps an aircraft in the air
senses.definitionCN: 使飞行器留在空中的向上之力
senses.example: Wing design increases lift.
senses.exampleCN: 机翼设计可增加升力。
senses.why: Air pushes the plane up just as hands push a box up.
senses.whyCN: 空气托起飞机，正如双手托起箱子。

intro.en: Lift comes from Old Norse lypta 'to raise', from Germanic roots of raising; English took it from the settlers and it grew many senses.
intro.cn: lift 来自古诺斯语 lypta「举起」，出自日耳曼「抬升」词根；英语从定居者处借得并衍生多义。

items.en: Old Norse lypta meant 'to lift, raise' and settled into northern English.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 lypta 意为「举起」，落脚于英格兰北部。

items.en: The Norse verb belongs to a Germanic raising family, kin to German lüpfen.
items.cn: 诺斯动词属日耳曼「抬升」词族，与德语 lüpfen 有亲缘。

items.en: In Middle English lift spread from hands to spirits and rules.
items.cn: 中古英语里 lift 从双手扩展到情绪与规则。

items.en: Modern English added the elevator name, the free ride, plagiarism and aviation senses.
items.cn: 现代英语新增电梯名、搭便车、剽窃与航空义。

items.en: Source uncertain (root only): the deeper origin of the raising family beyond Germanic is debated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅词根）：抬升词族在日耳曼语之前的来源有争议。

entries.definition: The moment a rocket leaves the ground.
entries.definitionCN: 火箭离地的时刻。

entries.definition: To lift and set in a higher place; lift stresses the effort.
entries.definitionCN: 抬起并置于高处；lift 强调费力。

entries.definition: To lift heavy things with ropes or machines.
entries.definitionCN: 用绳索或机械吊起重物。

entries.definition: To lift or pull with great effort.
entries.definitionCN: 用力举或拉。

entries.definitionCN: 美式说法，对应英式 lift。

normal.cn: 古诺斯语 lypta 意为举起；英格兰北部保留了它。

normal.cn: 英式 lift 等于美式 elevator。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: lift up, give someone a lift, lift a finger.

normal.en: Moods lift, bans lift, prices lift spirits.
normal.cn: 情绪可振、禁令可解、消息可提神。

normal.cn: 机翼升力让飞机留在天上。

abstract.cn: 想象杠铃从地面颤抖着升起。

abstract.en: Picture grey clouds parting and one sunbeam lifting the street.
abstract.cn: 想象乌云裂开，一束光提振了整条街。

abstract.en: Picture a thumb up at the roadside, a car slowing down.
abstract.cn: 想象路边竖起的拇指，一辆车缓缓停下。

examples.en: He lifted the sleeping child out of the car.
examples.cn: 他把睡着的孩子从车里抱出来。

examples.en: The government lifted the ban on night flights.
examples.cn: 政府解除了夜航禁令。

examples.en: Reading that poem lifted my spirits for days.
examples.cn: 那首诗让我振奋了好几天。

branches.en: HANDS AT WORK: the plain act of raising a thing.
branches.cn: 双手出力：抬物这一朴素动作。

branches.cn: 被抬起的情绪与规则：心情上扬，限制解除。

definition_zh: 光；光线；灯；明亮；浅色的；轻的；点燃；照亮
definition_en: the natural agent that makes things visible, or something that produces it; also pale in colour or not heavy
core_image: 一束细光穿过棱镜，在墙上散成彩色条纹
scene: 一束细光穿过棱镜，在墙上散成彩色条纹。A thin beam of light passes through the prism and spreads into colours.
sceneCN: 这里 light 指「使人能看见物体的那种辐射」（第 1 个义项：眼睛可感知的电磁辐射）；句意为一束细光穿过棱镜，在墙上散成彩色条纹。可辨识物件：细光束、棱镜、墙上条纹、暗室。

senses.title: Radiation the eye can see
senses.definition: the band of electromagnetic radiation that the human eye can detect, making objects visible
senses.definitionCN: 人眼能探测到的电磁辐射波段，使物体可见
senses.example: A thin beam of light passes through the prism and spreads into colours.
senses.exampleCN: 一束细光穿过棱镜，散成彩色条纹。
senses.why: the word is native English and named brightness long before physics described it as a band of radiation.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是英语本族词，在物理学把它描述为一段辐射之前很久，就指「明亮」。

senses.title: A lamp or other source
senses.definition: a device or object that produces illumination, such as a lamp, a candle or a headlight
senses.definitionCN: 产生照明的装置或物体，如灯、蜡烛或车头灯
senses.example: She switched on the light above the kitchen table.
senses.exampleCN: 她打开了厨房桌子上方的灯。
senses.why: the effect and the thing that makes it are named by one word, as often happens with everyday nouns.
senses.whyCN: 效果与造成效果的物件共用一个词，这在日常名词中很常见。

senses.title: Brightness in a place
senses.definition: the amount of illumination present in a place, whether natural or artificial
senses.definitionCN: 某处现有的照明量，无论天然或人造
senses.example: The room filled with morning light.
senses.exampleCN: 房间里充满了晨光。
senses.why: the word can name an unbounded mass of brightness, not only a countable lamp.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以指一片无边界的明亮，而不只是可数的灯。

senses.title: Pale in colour
senses.definition: describing a colour that is pale rather than deep, as in light blue or light grey
senses.definitionCN: 描述颜色浅而非深，如浅蓝或浅灰
senses.example: The walls were painted a light grey.
senses.exampleCN: 墙被刷成浅灰色。
senses.why: a pale surface reflects more light, so the word for brightness came to describe weak colour.
senses.whyCN: 浅色表面反射更多光，因此表示明亮的词转而描述淡的颜色。

senses.title: Not heavy
senses.definition: having little weight, or easy to lift and carry
senses.definitionCN: 重量小，或容易搬动携带
senses.example: The case was light enough to carry in one hand.
senses.exampleCN: 这只箱子轻到一只手就能提。
senses.why: this is a different word from the brightness sense, though the two spellings merged; it goes back to a Germanic root for easy to lift.
senses.whyCN: 这一义与「明亮」义本是不同的词，只是拼写合并了；它上溯到表示「容易提起」的日耳曼词根。

senses.title: To set something burning
senses.definition: to start a fire or make something begin to burn
senses.definitionCN: 生起火，或使某物开始燃烧
senses.example: He lit a candle and set it on the windowsill.
senses.exampleCN: 他点了一支蜡烛，放在窗台上。
senses.why: the verb comes from the brightness word: to light something is to give it a flame.
senses.whyCN: 动词来自「明亮」这个词：给某物点上火，就是让它发光。

senses.title: To illuminate
senses.definition: to provide light for a place or an object so that it can be seen
senses.definitionCN: 为某处或某物提供光，使其可见
senses.example: A single lamp lit the whole stairwell.
senses.exampleCN: 一盏灯照亮了整个楼梯间。
senses.why: the transitive verb reverses the noun: what was bright is now made bright by someone.
senses.whyCN: 及物动词把名词反过来：原本明亮的东西，现在被人使它变亮。

senses.title: Understanding or insight
senses.definition: information or understanding that makes a difficult matter clear
senses.definitionCN: 使困难之事变得清楚的信息或理解
senses.example: The letters shed light on why the project was abandoned.
senses.exampleCN: 这些信件为项目为何被放弃提供了线索。
senses.why: seeing has always stood for understanding, so light became the standard figure for insight.
senses.whyCN: 「看见」一向代表「理解」，因此 light 成了表示「洞见」的标准比喻。

intro.en: Light has two unrelated histories that share one spelling: the brightness word and the not-heavy word both come from Old English but from different roots. Latin lux is a cognate, not an ancestor.
intro.cn: light 有两个彼此无关、却共用同一拼写的历史：「明亮」与「不重」都来自古英语，但词根不同。拉丁 lux 是同源词，而非祖先。

items.en: Leoht meant light or brightness, from a Germanic root also seen in German Licht. It is related to Latin lux by common ancestry, not by borrowing.
items.cn: leoht 意为「光、明亮」，来自一个也在德语 Licht 中出现的日耳曼词根；它与拉丁 lux 是同源关系，而非借用。

items.en: A second leoht meant not heavy or easy to lift, from a different Germanic root; the two words fell together in Middle English spelling.
items.cn: 另一个 leoht 意为「不重、容易提起」，来自不同的日耳曼词根；两个词在中古英语的拼写上合流。

items.en: The verb light, to set burning or to illuminate, developed from the brightness noun in Old English.
items.cn: 动词 light「点燃、照亮」在古英语中由表示明亮的名词发展而来。

items.en: From the seventeenth century light was studied as rays and waves, and later as one band of the electromagnetic spectrum.
items.cn: 从十七世纪起，光被作为光线与波研究，后来又作为电磁波谱中的一段。

items.en: Shed light on and see the light extend brightness to understanding, a figure already old in English.
items.cn: 「向某事投光」与「看见光」把明亮延伸到理解，这一比喻在英语中已很古老。

items.en: Source uncertain (roots only): the two Germanic roots behind the spellings have no fully settled pre-history, so the reconstructed forms commonly cited for them are reconstructions.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅词根）：这两个日耳曼词根的更早历史都没有完全定论，因此常被引用的重构形式应视为重构。

note.en: Group one holds words that look like light but belong to different families; group two holds the nouns and verbs that overlap its senses.
note.cn: 第一组是形近却属于不同词族的词；第二组是与其义项重叠的名词与动词。

entries.definition: The sudden electrical flash in a storm; it is a different noun and contains no sense of weight.
entries.definitionCN: 风暴中突然的电闪；它是另一个名词，也不含重量之义。

entries.definition: Either to make brighter or to make less heavy, because it was built from both senses of light.
entries.definitionCN: 既可指「使变亮」，也可指「减轻」，因为它由 light 的两个义项共同派生。

entries.definition: In a light manner, either gently or without seriousness; it modifies an action rather than naming light.
entries.definitionCN: 以轻的方式，或轻柔，或不认真；它修饰动作，而非命名光。

entries.definition: A tower with a lamp for guiding ships; the compound uses the source sense of light.
entries.definitionCN: 为船只导航的灯塔建筑；这一复合词用的是 light 的「光源」义。

entries.definition: A device that gives light, typically a bulb or a flame in a holder; it is the object, not the radiation.
entries.definitionCN: 发出光的装置，通常是带座的灯泡或火焰；它是物件，不是辐射。

entries.definition: The supply or level of light in a place, used in technical and formal writing.
entries.definitionCN: 某处光照的供给或水平，多用于技术与正式写作。

entries.definition: A steady soft light without flame, as from hot metal or a screen.
entries.definitionCN: 无火焰的稳定柔光，如灼热金属或屏幕发出的。

entries.definition: The intensity of light as perceived or measured; it is the property, while light is the thing.
entries.definitionCN: 被感知或测量到的光强；它是属性，而 light 是事物本身。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real native roots, the real verb family and the real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的本族词根、真实的动词词族，以及真实的固定搭配。

normal.en: Light and the German Licht descend from the same Germanic root.
normal.cn: light 与德语 Licht 出自同一个日耳曼词根。

normal.en: The not-heavy light is a separate word that happened to take the same spelling.
normal.cn: 表示「不重」的 light 是另一个词，只是碰巧拼写相同。

normal.en: The verb forms are lit and lighted, with lighting as the participle noun.
normal.cn: 动词形式是 lit 与 lighted，动名词是 lighting。

normal.en: Shed light on means explain, and see the light means come to understand.
normal.cn: 英语里「向某事投光」意为阐明，「看见光」意为明白过来。

normal.en: The Latin cognate is lux, which gives luminous and lucid, but English light is not borrowed from it.
normal.cn: 拉丁同源词是 lux，它给出 luminous 与 lucid，但英语 light 并非借自它。

abstract.en: Picture a match struck in a room where every object was only a guess.
abstract.cn: 想象在黑屋里划着一根火柴，此前每件东西都只是猜测。

abstract.en: Picture a page that was unreadable until one sentence made all of it clear.
abstract.cn: 想象一页原本读不懂的文字，因一句话而全部清楚。

abstract.en: Picture a feather and a stone held in the same hand, one easy and one not.
abstract.cn: 想象同一只手里拿着一根羽毛与一块石头，一个轻松，一个不轻松。

examples.en: The speed of light in a vacuum is about three hundred million metres per second.
examples.cn: 真空中的光速约为每秒三亿米。

examples.en: Please turn off the lights when you leave the room.
examples.cn: 离开房间时请把灯关掉。

examples.en: The new evidence shed light on a case that had been closed for decades.
examples.cn: 新证据为这桩尘封数十年的案子提供了线索。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「light」两义同形：亮的东西 → 光、灯；提起来不费劲 → 轻的；让火亮起来 → 点燃

root: 英语本族词，两个同形异源：表示「光、明亮」的 light 出自古英语 leoht（日耳曼词根，与拉丁 lux 同源而非借用）；表示「不重」的 light 出自另一个古英语 leoht（不同日耳曼词根）。无拉丁同族，故本词条不列拉丁借词。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses begin with the radiation, then the lamp, the brightness of a place, pale colour, lightness of weight, fire, illumination and finally understanding.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从辐射开始，随后是灯、某处的明亮、浅色、重量之轻、点火、照明，最后落在理解。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a narrow beam splitting into colour on a wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：一束窄光在墙上分成彩色。

branches.en: RADIATION AND FILL: the same word names both the agent and the amount of it in a place.
branches.cn: 辐射与充盈：同一个词既指作用的媒介，也指某处该媒介的量。

branches.en: SOURCE AND ACTION: a lamp, the act of igniting, and the act of illuminating all circle the same brightness.
branches.cn: 源与动作：灯、点燃的动作、照亮的动作，都围绕同一份明亮。

branches.en: PALE COLOUR: a surface that reflects much light is called light in colour.
branches.cn: 浅色：反射大量光的表面，被称为颜色浅。

branches.en: A SEPARATE WORD: not heavy shares the spelling but not the root.
branches.cn: 另一个词：表示「不重」的词共用拼写，却不共用词根。

branches.en: INSIGHT: seeing becomes understanding, the oldest figure in the word.
branches.cn: 洞见：看见变成理解，这是这个词最古老的比喻。

intro.en: Light is a native English word, so its family is built by ordinary English suffixes and compounds rather than by Latin affixes.
intro.cn: light 是英语本族词，其词族靠普通英语后缀与复合来构建，而非拉丁词缀。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root behind the English word: lux and lucere are cognates, not ancestors, so no Latin borrowing stands behind it; the Latin forms sometimes quoted are only relatives.
latinIntro.cn: 英语这个词背后没有拉丁词根：lux 与 lucere 是同源词，而非祖先，没有拉丁借词为其源头；有时引用的拉丁形式只是亲属词。

items.structure: light (native English noun and adjective, Old English leoht)

items.example: The lights went out at midnight.

items.meaning: the arrangement or use of light
items.example: The stage lighting was too harsh.

items.meaning: less heavy; a device that makes a flame
items.example: This bag is lighter than the other.
The lightness of the fabric surprised him.

items.meaning: to brighten, or to reduce weight
a tower with a guiding lamp
items.example: The lighthouse flashed every ten seconds.
The sun is the main light source.

definition_zh: 喜欢；像；如同；类似的人或物
definition_en: to find pleasure in something; to be similar to; in the same way as; a similar person or thing
core_image: 两张形状几乎重合的影子；或摊开的手心接纳喜欢之物
scene: 午后操场，两个身影并肩跑过弯道。Run like the wind and do not look back.
sceneCN: 这里 like 是介词「像、如同」（第 3 个义项：像……一样）；句意为像风一样奔跑，不要回头。

derivatives.zh: like 加 -ly，指「可能的；有希望的」
like 与 -wise 合成，指「同样地」
like 加 -ing 名词化，指「喜好；嗜好」
like 加动词后缀 -en，指「把……比作」

senses.title: To enjoy or be fond of
senses.definition: to find someone or something pleasant or enjoyable
senses.definitionCN: 觉得人或物令人愉悦
senses.example: I like quiet mornings best.
senses.exampleCN: 我最喜欢安静的清晨。
senses.why: Pleasure opens the hand to keep a thing near; liking is welcoming.
senses.whyCN: 愉悦让人伸手留住近旁之物，喜欢即是接纳。

senses.title: To want or choose
senses.definition: to prefer to have or do something
senses.definitionCN: 宁愿有或做某事
senses.example: Would you like some tea?
senses.exampleCN: 想喝点茶吗？
senses.why: Choosing is liking pointed at one thing, so offers use the same verb.
senses.whyCN: 选择是瞄准一事的喜欢，邀请便沿用此动词。

senses.title: Similar to; in the same way as
senses.definition: resembling someone or something; in the manner of
senses.definitionCN: 与……相似；以……的方式
senses.example: Run like the wind and do not look back.
senses.exampleCN: 像风一样奔跑，不要回头。
senses.why: Two shapes lie over each other; the comparison word grew from the sameness word.
senses.whyCN: 两个形影相叠；比较之词由「相同」之词长出。

senses.title: Such as; for example
senses.definition: used to give an example of a group
senses.definitionCN: 用于举例
senses.example: Cold drinks like lemonade sell fast in July.
senses.exampleCN: 柠檬水一类的冷饮七月卖得快。
senses.why: One member stands for the class it resembles.
senses.whyCN: 一个成员代表它所属的类。

senses.title: A similar person or thing
senses.definition: someone or something that resembles another
senses.definitionCN: 与另一者相似的人或物
senses.example: Rarely have I seen his like.
senses.exampleCN: 我很少见过与他相像的人。
senses.why: The comparison turned into the thing compared: his double is "his like".
senses.whyCN: 比较变成了被比者本身：他的翻版即 his like。

senses.title: Likely or characteristic
senses.definition: showing what usually happens, as in like clockwork
senses.definitionCN: 显示通常情形，如 like clockwork
senses.example: The old clock starts like clockwork at six.
senses.exampleCN: 老钟六点准点报时，分毫不差。
senses.why: What a thing does regularly becomes "what it is like".
senses.whyCN: 事物惯常之举即「它像什么」。

senses.title: To approve on social media
senses.definition: to show approval of an online post with a click
senses.definitionCN: 点击表示对网络内容的赞许
senses.example: Her video got two thousand likes overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 她的视频一夜获得两千个赞。
senses.why: The old word of pleasure shrank into one click of approval.
senses.whyCN: 古老的愉悦词缩成一次点击的赞许。

intro.en: Like came into English as two words that merged. The sameness word comes from Old English gelic 'having the same form', from the body root lic; the liking word comes from Old English lician 'to please'.
intro.cn: like 以两个词进入英语并合流。「相同」词来自古英语 gelic「同形的」，出自身体词根 lic；「喜欢」词来自古英语 lician「使愉悦」。

items.en: Old English gelic meant 'alike, having the same body or form', built on lic 'body, corpse'.
items.cn: 古英语 gelic 意为「相似的、同体的」，建立在 lic「身体、躯体」之上。

items.en: The sameness root spread through Germanic: German gleich and Dutch gelijk keep it.
items.cn: 相同词根遍布日耳曼语族：德语 gleich、荷兰语 gelijk 保留至今。

items.en: Old English lician meant 'to please', used impersonally: it likes me meant I like it.
items.cn: 古英语 lician 意为「使愉悦」，用作无人称：it likes me 即「我喜欢它」。

items.en: In Middle English the two words merged in spelling and sound, and the senses interwove.
items.cn: 中古英语里两词形音合流，词义互相渗透。

items.en: Modern English kept both rails and added the social-media like in the twenty-first century.
items.cn: 现代英语保留两条轨，并在二十一世纪新增社交点赞义。

note.en: Group one flags the merged twins; group two lists comparison and pleasure words.
note.cn: 第一组标出合流的双生词；第二组列出比较与愉悦词。

entries.definition: Probable; from the same merged word.
entries.definitionCN: 可能的；出自同一个合流词。

entries.definition: In the same way.
entries.definitionCN: 同样地。

entries.definition: To pass the tongue over; one letter apart.
entries.definitionCN: 舔；差一个字母，词根不同。

entries.definition: To take pleasure actively; like is broader.
entries.definitionCN: 主动取乐；like 更宽泛。

entries.definition: Resembling but not identical; like is looser.
entries.definitionCN: 相似但不全同；like 更宽。

entries.definition: A stronger word of affection.
entries.definitionCN: 更强烈的喜爱。

entries.definition: To like one choice more than another.
entries.definitionCN: 在多选之间更喜欢其一。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the two merged roots and real phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用合流的两个词根与真实短语。

normal.en: Two words merged: gelic (same form) and lician (to please).
normal.cn: 两个词合流：gelic（同形）与 lician（使愉悦）。

normal.en: Old English used it impersonally: it likes me meant I like it.
normal.cn: 古英语无人称用法：it likes me 即我喜欢它。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: would like, feel like, like mad, and the like.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：想要、想要/像、拼命地、诸如此类。

normal.en: German gleich is a cousin of the sameness word.
normal.cn: 德语 gleich 是「相同」义的表亲。

normal.en: The modern like button borrowed the pleasure word.
normal.cn: 现代点赞按钮借用了「愉悦」词。

abstract.en: Picture two shadows overlapping on a sunny wall.
abstract.cn: 想象阳光墙上两道重合的影子。

abstract.en: Picture a hand gently pulling a book closer.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手轻轻把书拉近。

abstract.en: Picture a thumb tapping a small heart on a screen.
abstract.cn: 想象拇指在屏幕上轻点一颗小红心。

examples.en: Children like stories with animals in them.
examples.cn: 孩子们喜欢有动物的故事。

examples.en: She sings like a nightingale.
examples.cn: 她唱歌像夜莺一样动听。

examples.en: He acts like he owns the place.
examples.cn: 他表现得像这地方是他的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「来客」——喜欢的客人来了；长得像的客人像一家人 → 喜欢；像

root: 「相同」义：古英语 gelic「同形」（lic「身体」词根）；「喜欢」义：古英语 lician「使愉悦」；两词在中古英语合流。

sensesIntro.en: Seven senses keep both merged rails: pleasure taken and kept near, and sameness between two things — in resemblance, examples, doubles, habits, and clicks.
sensesIntro.cn: 七个义项守住合流的双轨：取乐并留近旁；两物相同——在形似、举例、翻版、习性与点击之中。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two shapes overlap; a hand draws a thing closer.
core.cn: 核心意象：两影重叠；一只手把物拉近。

branches.en: WELCOMING PLEASURE: enjoying and choosing.
branches.cn: 悦纳之乐：喜爱与选择。

branches.en: OVERLAPPING SHAPES: resemblance in manner and form.
branches.cn: 重叠之影：方式与形状的相似。

branches.en: ONE STANDS FOR ALL: examples use the resemblance.
branches.cn: 以一代类：举例借用相似。

branches.en: THE DOUBLE AND THE HABIT: his like, and like clockwork.
branches.cn: 翻版与习性：his like 与 like clockwork。

branches.en: ONE CLICK OF PLEASURE: the modern approval.
branches.cn: 一次点击的愉悦：现代的赞许。

intro.en: Like carries two native roots and no prefixes; the family grows with native suffixes.
intro.cn: like 携两个本族词根且无前缀；词族以本族后缀生长。

latinIntro.en: No established Latin cognate exists, so the Latin section stays empty; the items show native suffix work.
latinIntro.cn: 没有确证的拉丁同族词，拉丁部分留空；条目展示本族后缀加工。

items.example: She has a liking for jazz.
The idiom keeps the old sense.

definition_zh: 线；排；行；线条；台词；线路；排队
definition_en: a long narrow mark; a row of people or things; written words in a row; words spoken by an actor; a wire carrying messages; to stand in a row
core_image: 一根拉直的细绳，从这头到那头
scene: 开学第一课，他用粉笔在黑板上划下一条直线。Please line up outside the hall.
sceneCN: 这里 line 是动词「排队」（第 7 个义项：站成一排）；句意为请在大厅外排好队。

derivatives.zh: line 加拉丁式后缀 -ar，指「线的；线性的」
out 与 line 合成，指「轮廓；大纲」

senses.title: A long narrow mark
senses.definition: a long thin mark on a surface or an imagined one
senses.definitionCN: 表面细长的痕迹或想象中的线
senses.example: Draw a straight line between the two points.
senses.exampleCN: 在两点之间画一条直线。
senses.why: Stretched thread is the plain picture: one direction, no width.
senses.whyCN: 拉直的细绳是最朴素的画面：只有方向，没有宽度。

senses.title: A row of people or things
senses.definition: people or things standing one behind or beside another
senses.definitionCN: 人或物前后或左右排成一行
senses.example: A long line formed outside the bakery.
senses.exampleCN: 面包房外排起了长队。
senses.why: Things arranged along the thread become a row.
senses.whyCN: 沿细绳排开的物就成了一行。

senses.title: Written words in a row
senses.definition: a row of written or printed words
senses.definitionCN: 一行书写或印刷的文字
senses.example: Read the first line of each paragraph.
senses.exampleCN: 读每段的第一行。
senses.why: Writing follows the same stretched thread across the page.
senses.whyCN: 书写沿着同一条「细绳」横过纸面。

senses.title: Words an actor speaks
senses.definition: words an actor memorizes and says
senses.definitionCN: 演员背熟并说出的词句
senses.example: He forgot his lines in the second act.
senses.exampleCN: 他在第二幕忘了台词。
senses.why: Each spoken sentence is one row of the script.
senses.whyCN: 每句台词都是剧本中的一行。

senses.title: A wire or route carrying messages or transport
senses.definition: a wire carrying calls, or a route of buses, ships or trains
senses.definitionCN: 传电话的电线，或公交、船、火车的线路
senses.example: The phone line is busy.
senses.exampleCN: 电话占线。
senses.why: A route drawn across a map is a thread of travel or signal.
senses.whyCN: 地图上画出的路线就是行程或信号的「细绳」。

senses.title: A boundary or limit
senses.definition: a limit that should not be crossed
senses.definitionCN: 不应越过的一条界限
senses.example: Crossing that line costs trust.
senses.exampleCN: 越过那条线会失去信任。
senses.why: A thread drawn on the ground says: beyond this, stop.
senses.whyCN: 在地上拉一根绳，意思就是：过此即止。

senses.title: To stand or arrange in a row
senses.definition: to form or put into a row
senses.definitionCN: 排成一行或使成行
senses.example: Please line up outside the hall.
senses.exampleCN: 请在大厅外排好队。
senses.why: The noun hardened into a verb: making rows.
senses.whyCN: 名词固化为动词：制造行列。

senses.title: To cover the inside of
senses.definition: to put a layer of material on the inside of something
senses.definitionCN: 在某物内侧加一层材料
senses.example: Line the tin with baking paper.
senses.exampleCN: 在烤模里垫上烘焙纸。
senses.why: An inner layer "lines" the walls from within.
senses.whyCN: 内层从内部「沿线」贴附于壁。

intro.en: Line comes from Old French ligne, from Latin linea 'linen thread', from linum 'flax'; the stretched thread of flax gave every kind of line its name.
intro.cn: line 来自古法语 ligne，出自拉丁语 linea「亚麻线」（linum「亚麻」）；亚麻拉成的细线给各种「线」命了名。

items.en: Latin linum meant flax, the plant whose fibres made thread.
items.cn: 拉丁语 linum 指亚麻，其纤维可制线。

items.en: Latin linea meant a linen thread, then a drawn line, then a row.
items.cn: 拉丁语 linea 先指亚麻线，继指画线，再指行列。

items.en: Old French ligne carried the senses of thread, stroke and row.
items.cn: 古法语 ligne 承载线、笔画与行列诸义。

items.en: In Middle English line spread to writing rows, acting scripts and routes.
items.cn: 中古英语把 line 扩展到书写行、台词与路线。

items.en: Modern English added telephone lines, industry boundaries and the verb of lining garments.
items.cn: 现代英语新增电话线路、行业界线与给衣物衬里的动词。

note.en: Group one flags look-alikes; group two lists thread and row words.
note.cn: 第一组标出形近词；第二组列出线与行列之词。

entries.definition: Made of or along lines.
entries.definitionCN: 线的；线性的。

entries.definition: An arm or leg; shares three letters, unrelated root.
entries.definitionCN: 臂或腿；共享三字母，词根无关。

entries.definition: The inner covering layer of a garment.
entries.definitionCN: 衣物内层衬里。

entries.definition: Things side by side; line can also mean front-to-back.
entries.definitionCN: 并排之物；line 也可指前后纵列。

entries.definition: People waiting one behind another, chiefly British.
entries.definitionCN: 排队等候的人群，多用于英式。

entries.definition: The physical original of the word.
entries.definitionCN: 实物本源。

entries.definition: The edge of an area; matches the limit sense.
entries.definitionCN: 区域边缘；对应界限义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the flax trail and real phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用亚麻词路与真实短语。

normal.en: Latin linea meant linen thread, from linum, flax.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 linea 指亚麻线，出自 linum（亚麻）。

normal.en: Cousins: linear, lining, outline.
normal.cn: 同族词：linear、lining、outline。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: line up, in line with, hold the line, the bottom line.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：排队、与……一致、别挂断、底线。

normal.en: Actors forget lines; callers hold the line.
normal.cn: 演员忘台词；打电话的人别挂线。

normal.en: Draw a line between work and rest means set a limit.
normal.cn: 在work与rest之间draw a line 意为划定界限。

abstract.en: Picture one flax thread pulled tight between two nails.
abstract.cn: 想象一根亚麻线在两枚钉子间绷直。

abstract.en: Picture chalk crossing a blackboard in one stroke.
abstract.cn: 想象粉笔一笔横过黑板。

abstract.en: Picture coats turned inside out, smooth linings showing.
abstract.cn: 想象大衣翻过来，露出平整的衬里。

examples.en: Sign your name on the dotted line.
examples.cn: 在虚线上签下你的名字。

examples.en: People lined the streets to watch the parade.
examples.cn: 人们沿街排开观看游行。

examples.en: Her speech stayed in line with party policy.
examples.cn: 她的发言与党的政策保持一致。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「来恩」——一根线连来恩情 → 线；排队

root: 拉丁语 linum「亚麻」→ linea「亚麻线」→ 古法语 ligne → 英语 line；由拉直的细线引申出行、台词、线路与界限。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all follow one stretched thread: drawn marks, standing rows, written rows, spoken rows, routes, limits, making rows, and inner layers.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都循着同一根绷紧的线：画痕、人列、书写行、台词行、路线、界限、排队的动作与内层衬里。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thread pulled tight from one point to another.
core.cn: 核心意象：从一点绷到另一点的线。

branches.en: THE DRAWN MARK: the thread turned into geometry.
branches.cn: 画出的线：细绳变成了几何。

branches.en: PEOPLE AS ROWS: standing in line and lining others up.
branches.cn: 人成行列：自己排队与让他人列队。

branches.en: WORDS IN ROWS: printed lines and actor lines.
branches.cn: 成行的文字：印刷行与演员台词。

branches.en: THE LONG CONNECTION: routes, wires and boundaries.
branches.cn: 长长的连接：路线、电线与界线。

branches.en: THE INNER THREAD: lining clings close to the walls.
branches.cn: 内在的线：衬里紧贴内壁。

intro.en: Line is a borrowed noun with no prefixes; the family grows with Latin-style and native suffixes.
intro.cn: line 是无前缀的外来名词；词族靠拉丁式与本族后缀生长。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root linea gives true cousins like linear and lineage; the items also show English suffix work.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 linea 提供 linear、lineage 等真表亲；条目亦展示英语后缀加工。

items.example: Cars lined up at the gate.
items.exampleCN: 汽车在大门口排起长队。

items.example: A cousin of the same root.

definition_zh: 名单；清单；列表；把……列成表
definition_en: a series of names or items written one below another; to write items in such a series
core_image: 一列竖着写下的名字，一条接一条
scene: 出门前，她在冰箱门上贴了一张纸条。Check the packing list before you close the suitcase.
sceneCN: 这里 list 是「清单」（第 1 个义项：逐项写下的目录）；句意为合上行李箱前核对装箱清单。

derivatives.zh: list 加 -ing，指「列表；刊登信息」
与 list2（倾斜）相关，指「无精打采的」
list 与 agent 合成，指「（房产）挂牌经纪人」

senses.title: A series of written items
senses.definition: a set of names or items written one under another
senses.definitionCN: 逐项竖排写下的名字或条目
senses.example: Check the packing list before you close the suitcase.
senses.exampleCN: 合上行李箱前核对装箱清单。
senses.why: Items written one below another form the plain picture.
senses.whyCN: 逐项下写的东西构成最朴素的画面。

senses.title: To write items in a series
senses.definition: to write or put items into such a series
senses.definitionCN: 把条目写进或排入这样的系列
senses.example: The guide lists thirty waterfalls.
senses.exampleCN: 指南列出了三十处瀑布。
senses.why: The noun hardened into a verb: putting things into rows.
senses.whyCN: 名词固化为动词：把物排入行。

senses.title: An official register
senses.definition: an official published register of names or things
senses.definitionCN: 官方公布的名册或目录
senses.example: The waiting list doubles every winter.
senses.exampleCN: 候补名单每年冬天翻倍。
senses.why: Registers are just lists with authority attached.
senses.whyCN: 名录就是附上权威的清单。

senses.title: A border strip (old use)
senses.definition: a border or edge strip, as in the old phrase the list of the field
senses.definitionCN: 边界或镶边，如旧语 the list of the field
senses.example: Knights met within the lists.
senses.exampleCN: 骑士们在其界内比武。
senses.why: A border marked where the contest began and ended.
senses.whyCN: 边界标出比武的起止。

senses.title: To lean to one side
senses.definition: to lean over to one side, said of ships
senses.definitionCN: 指船身向一侧倾侧
senses.example: The old ferry listed after the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 渡轮在风暴后倾斜了。
senses.why: A ship tips like a leaning column; this is a different, nautical word.
senses.whyCN: 船像倾斜的柱子；这是另一个航海用词。

senses.title: A cut edge of cloth
senses.definition: the selvage or list of cloth where threads finish
senses.definitionCN: 布料收边的织边
senses.example: The old coat shows its lists at the cuff.
senses.exampleCN: 旧大衣袖口露出布边。
senses.why: The border sense also lived in weaving.
senses.whyCN: 边界义也活在织造里。

senses.title: To set a price publicly
senses.definition: to state publicly the price of something for sale
senses.definitionCN: 公开标出售价
senses.example: The flat lists at two million.
senses.exampleCN: 这套公寓挂牌两百万。
senses.why: Goods entered on a price list take that price.
senses.whyCN: 进入价目表的货便取其价。

intro.en: The list of items comes from Old French liste 'border, edge strip', from Italian lista, likely from a Germanic word for a strip; the written row grew from a marked border. The ship\u0027s list is a separate Germanic word.
intro.cn: 条目之 list 来自古法语 liste「边条、镶边」，出自意大利语 lista，很可能源于日耳曼语「窄条」一词；书写的行列从「标出的边界」发展而来。船之倾斜是另一个日耳曼词。

items.en: A Germanic word for a strip or border is the likely origin of the border family.
items.cn: 日耳曼语「窄条、边界」一词很可能是边界词族的源头。

items.en: Italian lista meant a strip or border, and passed north with trade.
items.cn: 意大利语 lista 指窄条或镶边，随贸易北传。

items.en: Old French liste kept the border sense and added contest boundaries.
items.cn: 古法语 liste 保留边界义，并新增竞技场界线。

items.en: In Middle English the border became a written row of items.
items.cn: 中古英语里边界演变为书写的条目行列。

items.en: Modern English added official registers, prices, and kept the separate nautical list.
items.cn: 现代英语新增官方名录、标价，并保留独立的航海倾斜义。

note.en: Group one flags look-alikes; group two lists registers and rows.
note.cn: 第一组标出形近词；第二组列出名录与行列之词。

entries.definition: To pay attention with the ear; shares five letters, a different root.
entries.definitionCN: 用耳倾听；共享五字母，词根不同。

entries.definition: An entry in a catalogue or an act of listing.
entries.definitionCN: 目录中的一项或列举动。

entries.definition: The beam above a door; no kinship.
entries.definitionCN: 门楣；无亲缘。

entries.definition: A complete, organized list, often published.
entries.definitionCN: 完整有序的目录，常印行。

entries.definition: An official list of names or events.
entries.definitionCN: 官方的名册或记录。

entries.definition: A list of people on duty.
entries.definitionCN: 值班人员名单。

entries.definition: Things in a line, not necessarily written.
entries.definitionCN: 成行之物，不一定是写下的。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the border trail and real phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用边界词路与真实短语。

normal.en: The written row began as a border strip, from Italian lista.
normal.cn: 书写行列源于边条，出自意大利语 lista。

normal.en: Knights once fought within the lists of the field.
normal.cn: 骑士曾于赛场界内比武。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: shopping list, wait list, blacklist.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：购物单、候补名单、黑名单。

normal.en: Ships list to one side in a storm — a separate word.
normal.cn: 风暴中船身倾斜——那是另一个词。

normal.en: Listless may come from the leaning list: lacking drive.
normal.cn: listless 可能出自倾斜义：缺了劲头。

abstract.en: Picture ten names stacked down one narrow page.
abstract.cn: 想象十行名字竖着排满窄窄一页。

abstract.en: Picture a knight stepping over a rope into the field.
abstract.cn: 想象骑士跨过界绳进入赛场。

abstract.en: Picture a ferry leaning as the waves push one side.
abstract.cn: 想象渡轮在水浪推压一侧时倾斜。

examples.en: Write your three choices on this list.
examples.cn: 把你的三个选项写在这张单子上。

examples.en: The hotel is fully booked, but we are on the wait list.
examples.cn: 酒店订满了，但我们在候补名单上。

examples.en: The boat listed badly until the cargo was shifted.
examples.cn: 货移走之前，船倾得很厉害。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「列斯特」——列得整齐最舒服 → 清单；列表

root: 条目义：古法语 liste「边条」（意大利语 lista，日耳曼来源）→ 书写的行列；倾斜义为独立的日耳曼航海词。

sensesIntro.en: Seven senses gather at one edge: written rows, official registers, contest borders, woven edges, leaning hulls, and public prices.
sensesIntro.cn: 七个义项聚于同一条边：书写行列、官方名录、赛场边界、织边、倾斜的船体与公开标价。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a marked strip that orders what lies along it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条标出的窄条，为沿其排列之物定序。

branches.en: THE WRITTEN ROW: items stacked one under another.
branches.cn: 书写行列：条目逐一下排。

branches.en: THE ROW WITH AUTHORITY: official registers.
branches.cn: 带权威的行列：官方名录。

branches.en: THE OLD BORDER: contest bounds and woven edges.
branches.cn: 旧边界：赛场界与织边。

branches.en: THE OTHER RAIL: a ship leaning to one side.
branches.cn: 另一条轨：船身侧倾。

branches.en: PRICES IN A ROW: goods take the listed price.
branches.cn: 成排的价格：货物取挂牌价。

intro.en: List is a borrowed noun with no prefixes; the family adds native suffixes and compounds.
intro.cn: list 是无前缀的外来名词；词族靠本族后缀与复合构成。

latinIntro.en: No established Latin cognate exists, so the Latin section stays empty; the items show native word-building.
latinIntro.cn: 没有确证的拉丁同族词，拉丁部分留空；条目展示本族构词。

items.meaning: a border strip; a written row
